info.title: ArkRecord public resources
info.summary: Read-only public files of ArkRecord, the free, open-source Arknights / Arknights: Endfield gacha record tool.
info.description: ArkRecord (https://ark.kaltsit.dev/) keeps every player's records in their own browser and has no public user data. This document describes the public, read-only resources an agent can use: the site description for AI assistants, Markdown versions of the pages, and the build manifest for verifying the deployed code. Paths under /api/ serve only the site's own pages (same-origin only, rate-limited, and they need the player's own Hypergryph token); they are intentionally not described here and should not be called by agents.

get.summary: Home page, or its Markdown description
get.description: Browsers get the web app (it needs JavaScript). Send `Accept: text/markdown` to get the full Markdown description of the site instead. Every page path (/history, /stats, /data, /about, ...) answers the same way, with a short section about that page in front.

200.description: The web app, or Markdown when `text/markdown` is preferred in the Accept header.

get.summary: Short description of the site for AI assistants
Full description: features, how to use, privacy, verification, FAQ
Build manifest of the current deployment
get.description: SHA-256 of every file the site serves and of the server (Worker) code, with the commit and the GitHub Actions run that built and deployed them. Each manifest has a GitHub build attestation in Sigstore's public transparency log; verify it with `gh attestation verify build-manifest.json --repo DuskXi/ArkRecord-Web --signer-workflow DuskXi/ArkRecord-Web/.github/workflows/deploy-production.yml`.
